meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card that says what will happen, the folder (Shared Drive / Archive / 2019), the number of files (214, all older than 2020) and the space freed (3.2 GB), and that it cannot be undone. Give me a way to see the first five file names (Q1-2019-budget.xlsx, meeting-notes-2018-03.docx, old-logo-draft-v2.png, onboarding-2017.pdf, team-photo-2016.jpg, and 209 more) and Approve and Deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision (Approved or Denied) and locks: no buttons left.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Delete 214 old files?" "Approval needed" icon:"delete_outline" status:"Waiting" tone:warn w:390
  state decision=""
  if decision==""
    Paragraph "I will permanently delete 214 old files from your shared drive to free up space. Nothing is deleted until you approve."
    Details rows:[["Folder","Shared Drive / Archive / 2019"],["Files","214, all older than 2020"],["Space freed","3.2 GB"]]
    Callout "This cannot be undone" "Deleted files are removed for good and cannot be restored." tone:danger
    Disclosure "See the first five file names" lines:["Q1-2019-budget.xlsx","meeting-notes-2018-03.docx","old-logo-draft-v2.png","onboarding-2017.pdf","team-photo-2016.jpg","and 209 more"]
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Deny" tone:quiet -> decision="denied"
      ActionButton "Approve" tone:danger -> decision="approved"
  if decision=="approved"
    Receipt "Approved" "214 files in Shared Drive / Archive / 2019 are being deleted. 3.2 GB will be freed." tone:good icon:"check"
  if decision=="denied"
    Receipt "Denied" "Nothing was deleted. The 214 files are still in Shared Drive / Archive / 2019." tone:neutral icon:"close"
